title: Reproduce the trace
prompt: Implement `process` exactly as the lesson's trace describes: pass 1 transforms in place (evens halved and counted, odds doubled-plus-one), pass 2 sums, return sum − count. Verify your trace table predicts process({3, 4, 5}) == 19 before submitting.
